LESSON: SPEAKING FLUENCY: PRONUNCIATION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1.1: Speaking Fluency: pronunciation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Speaking Fluency: pronunciation
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to speak accurately and express the right feelings?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. construct sentences orally using words related to the theme
2. speak accurately, at the right speed and with expression on a given topic
3. use vocabulary related to the theme correctly in oral communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Speaking Fluency: pronunciation

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Speaking Fluency: pronunciation

Teach
• Focus skill: construct sentences orally using words related to the theme.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Speaking Fluency: pronunciation.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Speaking Fluency: pronunciation
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to speak accurately and express the right feelings?
2. How can you listen more attentively?
3. Which words do you use to talk about diseases?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
